note: Both sets contain four significant binding errors where Keynotes A1/A4 and B1/B4 are swapped with their corresponding beam descriptions (e.g., claiming Grid 6 is associated with A4 instead of A1). Set B is preferred because it correctly captures the 'E6' Keynote for the Roof Beam at Grid 2,3,4,5, whereas Set A omits this critical identifier entirely. While Set A provides a more complete text description for the C1 beam, missing the E6 label is a greater loss of engineering reference data. Set B includes a redundant duplicate claim for the E6 beam.
